name: CyberNova NFK Otome
source:
Following the mysterious death of her boyfriend, Chris, MC moves to another city to try to find out more about what happened and investigate the company Chip-on. Once settled, she begins working as a detective for the NFK, while also dealing with her own grief. In her new city, she meets many people and experiences new realities that gradually become significant in her life, leading her to the difficult situation of having to let go of the memory of Chris.

[Translated from [url=https://ravenanikiri.itch.io/cybernova-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
